recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a female musician holding a yellow semi-hollow body electric guitar, set against a dual-textured background of solid white and gray floral wallpaper. The aesthetic blends soft feminine fashion with gritty, illustrative typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant pink of the off-the-shoulder top contrasts against the muted gray and white background.
The diagonal line of the guitar neck leads the eye from the bottom right toward the subject's face.
The distressed, illustrative text in the upper left balances the visual weight of the subject on the right.
coreInvariants: Yellow semi-hollow body guitar with f-hole
Gray damask or floral wallpaper pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned slightly off-center to the right, occupying approximately two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The yellow guitar body serves as the primary color anchor in the lower half of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright pink top, moves down the guitar neck, and follows the gaze of the subject back up to the stylized text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left quadrant is utilized for the artist's name and album title.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements (clothing, guitar) against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to warm wood tones and cool grays

letterConstructionRules: Extended, curly swashes and flourishes on terminals
Varied baseline for a jittery, organic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated, vine-like descenders and ascenders
Lowercase letters are compact with high contrast strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, expressive display script paired with a smaller, cleaner lowercase serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Bleeding Cowboys or similar grunge serifs

candidateDirections.reason: The original is highly unique and integrated with flourishes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a woman with brown hair wearing a pink off-the-shoulder ruffled top, holding a yellow semi-hollow electric guitar. The background should be split: the bottom half white, the top half a gray and white floral damask wallpaper pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-drawn black lettering in the top left corner. The letters should have a distressed ink texture and long, curly swashes that look like vines.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar a yellow semi-hollow body?
Is the text distressed and illustrative?
Is the background a mix of solid white and floral pattern?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the grunge texture on the text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
Any specific brand logos on the guitar headstock

mustAchieve: Soft, natural lighting on the subject
Tactile, inked feel to the typography
Clear separation between foreground and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar neck does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the text flourishes do not clutter the composition.
Verify the pink of the shirt is vibrant but not neon.
Confirm the wallpaper pattern is subtle and low-contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Musician) + Instrument (Yellow Guitar) + Background (Floral/Solid Split) + Typography (Distressed Illustrative Serif) = Indie Pop Album Aesthetic
